metadata.purpose: Short class-level semantic anchors for VadCLIP prototype experiments
notes: Prototype text avoids explicit UCF-Crime class labels where practical.
The goal is to reduce semantic dilution from long descriptive prototypes.
These prototypes are intended as compact text anchors, not full video descriptions.

compact_prototypes.text: repeated force against vulnerable targets
harsh grabbing striking or restraining of a weaker target
A dominant person repeatedly uses force while the target struggles or cannot withdraw.
officer restraint and removal
uniformed officers restrain search and escort a person
Officers physically control a person, secure their movement, and guide them away.
deliberate ignition of property
a person applies fire to fuel or property
Someone ignites a surface or object, then moves away as flames spread.
close physical attack
people strike push grab or pin another person
A confrontation turns into repeated force, causing someone to fall or retreat.
forced entry and property removal
people break into a place and carry items away
Intruders force access, search inside rooms, gather objects, and leave quickly together.
sudden fireball and smoke
an object ignites with flames smoke and debris
A vehicle or object erupts suddenly, producing flames, smoke, and scattered debris.
mutual group physical struggle
people exchange blows grapple and shove each other
Two or more people engage in back-and-forth striking, pushing, or grappling movement.
routine everyday activity
people move interact work or travel without disruption
People and vehicles continue ordinary behavior without visible conflict or sudden disruption.
vehicle collision and impact
vehicles collide skid overturn or strike people in traffic
Traffic movement abruptly turns into impact, loss of control, or people falling.
coerced taking of valuables
threatening people to surrender cash or personal belongings
A person uses threat or force to make others hand over property.
gunfire and people reacting
a person aims or fires while others flee
An armed person points or fires, causing nearby people to scatter or fall.
concealed merchandise departure
a shopper hides items and moves toward exit
Someone handles store goods, conceals selected items, and leaves the retail area.
unauthorized taking of property
a person secretly takes unattended belongings and leaves
Someone approaches unattended property, removes it discreetly, and departs with it quickly.
intentional damage to property
people strike break spray or damage public objects
A person deliberately damages vehicles, walls, windows, or objects before moving away.
